sourceFindings: Source broker preparation passes the selected checkout release lock; prebuilt broker preparation keeps the maintenance package lock. Runtime acquisition occurs in the existing owned preparation worker after the first UI frame. It adds no Swift model or adapter download and keeps immutable inventory, hash and architecture checks.

The native executable is verified before expensive model hashing or credential creation. The verified read guard is moved into the process specification and retained with the launched service; existing process ownership, sandbox, admission and explicit Retry semantics remain intact.

NativeRuntime classification requires a complete exact broker diagnostic line and native-engine selection. Model and adapter failures retain their own guidance. The new startup phase contains only a fixed enum name.

The repair script resolves the maintenance executable once, checks its compiled version, source commit, target and archive digest, then provisions through that same executable. Missing older capability fields or mismatches throw before mutation. PowerShell single-quoted ASCII JSON preserves apostrophes, Unicode surrogate pairs and the selected data directory. Application, broker and maintenance executables must still come from their supported matching source/package identities.

The budget tool defaults to 300 whole-job seconds and 240 maximum case seconds. Explicit whole-job bounds 300..900 remain finite; the workflow offers 5/10/15 minutes and requires a bounded reason for 10/15 before checkout or intake. It passes the same selected total to child receipts.

Budget calculation charges setup with ceiling arithmetic. Original inherited monotonic elapsed time and a shorter predeclared owner work allowance can only shorten the independent job allowance. Ten seconds remain between case and hard limits, thirty seconds for job postprocessing, and fifteen additional seconds for inherited owner exit.

Each affected model-case receipt reports selected whole-job, actual case and maximum case bounds. Narrower numerical, request-timing, accelerator and old external-helper limits remain effective; no historical clock or model matrix is reopened.

The release documentation binds current 0.1.14 source and retained owning/publication evidence without transferring historical 0.1.13 device results. The extended 840-second case still requires more than 4.88 generated tokens/s before prefill and cleanup for 4,096 output tokens; revised ceilings alone establish no feasibility or promotion.

The PLAN packet keeps one minimal service sequence and the independently required fresh owners for replay and original-PQ2 rollback. It leaves numerical, full-length, benefit, human and clean-machine gates pending.
